evaluate: function calculateFinancialCostPerKilometer(input:FinancialCostPerKilometerInput,limits:ExactLimits):FinancialCostPerKilometerResult{const ctx=prepareCostPerKilometer(input,limits);if(ctx.status==='unavailable')return Object.freeze({status:'unavailable',code:ctx.code,reason:ctx.reason,projection:ctx.projection,calculation:ctx.calculation});if(ctx.zeroDistance){const metric:FinancialCostPerKilometerMetric=Object.freeze({status:'unavailable',code:'zero-distance',reason:'total-distance é zero; métrica não calculável',calculation:null});return Object.freeze({status:'conditional',kind:'projection',contextId:ctx.projection.contextId,period:ctx.projection.period,financialAssessment:'not-evaluated',costCoverage:'not-evaluated',taxAssessment:'not-evaluated',costBasis:'planned-total-cost',distanceBasis:'total-distance',projection:ctx.projection,value:{totalDistance:ctx.totalDistance,costPerKilometer:metric}});}const costPerKilometer=calculateExactProduct('divide',ctx.projection.value.plannedTotalCost,ctx.totalDistance,ctx.limits);if(costPerKilometer.status==='unavailable')return Object.freeze({status:'unavailable',code:'calculation-unavailable',reason:costPerKilometer.reason,projection:ctx.projection,calculation:costPerKilometer});const metric:FinancialCostPerKilometerMetric=Object.freeze({status:'ready',value:costPerKilometer.value});return Object.freeze({status:'conditional',kind:'projection',contextId:ctx.projection.contextId,period:ctx.projection.period,financialAssessment:'not-evaluated',costCoverage:'not-evaluated',taxAssessment:'not-evaluated',costBasis:'planned-total-cost',distanceBasis:'total-distance',projection:ctx.projection,value:{totalDistance:ctx.totalDistance,costPerKilometer:metric}});}
